VoxMic optional DPDFNet backend - third-party notices
======================================================

This runtime payload contains unmodified third-party components used only
when the DPDFNet noise-reduction backend is selected.

1. sherpa-onnx v1.13.1
   Project: https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx
   License: Apache License 2.0
   The distributed DLL and C API are unmodified release artifacts.

2. ONNX Runtime
   Project: https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime
   License: MIT License (with third-party notices in the upstream project)
   The distributed ONNX Runtime DLLs are unmodified release dependencies
   supplied by the sherpa-onnx Windows package.

3. DPDFNet model: dpdfnet2_48khz_hr.onnx
   Model provenance: https://github.com/ceva-ip/DPDFNet
   Upstream model artifact: https://huggingface.co/Ceva-IP/DPDFNet
   The model is redistributed unmodified. Users and distributors must comply
   with the model provider's applicable terms for the selected artifact.

The exact dependency archive, model URL, and SHA-256 values are recorded by
the build preparation script and are not inferred from the files at runtime.
